tools.description: Retasc is not set up in this folder yet, so this is the only tool available and the only one that will work. Call it and follow what it returns. In short: YOU run `npx @retasc/cli@latest bind --json` in this folder, in the background, having first told your human that a browser is about to open. Pos

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: setup_status · Public sink: setup_status · Destructive: setup_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: setup_status · Public sink: setup_status · Destructive: setup_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
